verses.17:79: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَتَهَجَّدۡ بِهِۦ نَافِلَةࣰ لَّكَ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَبۡعَثَكَ رَبُّكَ مَقَامࣰ ا مَّحۡمُودࣰ ا

meaning: The root هجد (hjd) primarily means to sleep, especially at night. However, it also carries the opposite meaning: to remain awake or be sleepless at night, often for prayer.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
